session.name: CMP 2081-09 | Bring me Prince Charming
session.summary: The team met their Johnson duo, Baby Face and The Butcher, at Mama Appeltaart in Amsterdam and took on the job to kidnap the Vory Líder Grisha Semyonovich who basically never leaves the Vory controlled hookah bar "Sasha Lounge". After some scouting the team just entered as guests, found Grisha and convinced him to look at their car and maybe come along for a ride. Soon after that, a tranq patch sealed the deal. The team went to the safehouse as instructed, only to learn that a hostile armada was heading their way. Even though 7 players led to 35 gangers, they tore through their ranks via stun grenades and burst fire, leaving only few of them still somewhat alive by the time of the reinforcements. The cavalry at round 5 proved unnecessary. They assured that Grisha would leave the chat as alive as promised and left before the execution of the traitor happened.

session.name: CMP 2081-10 | A Diamond in The Rough
session.code: CMP 2081-10 | A Diamond in The Rough
session.summary: After getting hired by "Ms. Johnson" alias Kiara Shaw in the restaurant "Le GastroGnome" high in the "Space Needle-like" Europort Mast, the team travelled from Europort to Antwerp to enter the historical sewers of the Ruien and find a forgotten back door into the archives of a local security firm, Sinjoor Incorporated. After passing by some locals and hiring two former shadowrunners as guides, the team got ambushed by the rats living close to the door, but blasted through them. Gotten to the archives, their hacker took care of the host and all of the security features, making the copying of the data go swimmingly. The team got back to their Ms. Johnson, but did take a look at the plans and got a hunch of something bigger: they did copy security plans of the shops in Antwerp where the Queen of the United Netherlands, Amalia, got the ring for her daughter and her upcoming wedding.

session.name: CMP 2081-11 | Paved with good intentions
session.summary: The group met S-K Johnson Simon Andrews in an all-yellow interior bar at Utrecht and took on the mission to steal some crates off a secured convoy. They rescued an informant out of a soccer bar, learned some details and went about the heist as the vehicles got stuck in traffic. Using an Ares Scylla, they fried the convoy, got the stuff and left as quickly as they came.

session.name: CMP 2081-19: The Blue Moon of Kentucky
session.code: CMP 2081-19: The Blue Moon of Kentucky
session.summary: Dr Laureline Dodd discovered a lost city of T'In'Abula from the 4th age of the Dawn of Civilization. She protected the discovery, with help from the Governor, KSP, the artist sometimes known as Fox, and the local Naga Pit, from an incursion by Global Security.

session.name: 2026-June-03: SRM 2081-17: Framed in Blood
session.summary: Duan Yuhai hired the team to eliminate a rival triad's leader, David Guo. David and his team had been invested by blood spirits tracing back to blood sacrifice rituals in Central America hundreds of years ago.

session.name: 2026-June-06: CMP 2081-20: In the Cold Kentucky Rain
session.code: 2026-June-06: CMP 2081-20: In the Cold Kentucky Rain

session.name: 2026-June-12: CMP 2081-12 | Uneasy lies the head
session.summary: While the talk about and protests against the engagement of crown princess Emma reached their boiling point, the team got called by the orkish shadowrunner Sigrûn to The Hague's Noordeinde Paleis, where she reveals herself to be princess Emma's personal bodyguard and hires them to protect two palace officials during a trip through the city. As they tricked their way through a group of protesters they found out that the trip was about creating a chemsniffer primed on the chemical that's supposed to be used on an upcoming terrorist attack.

session.name: 2026-June-19: CMP 2083-14 | A Day at the Beach
session.code: 2026-June-19: CMP 2083-14 | A Day at the Beach
session.summary: : Arrived in Malta and asked by Thunder Corps to ensure that the demonstration of an the 'Silent Knight' Experimental Submarine went off without sabotage during a war game. After locating the submarine, we discovered a Leviathan attacking it. We were able to free the Leviathan from being controlled and rescued the submarine. Yuriko was yet again without matrix activity (due to being under a km of sea water and forced to inhabit a submarine).

session.name: 2026-June-20: CMP 2083-16 | War Never Changes
session.summary: : Hired by Col. Deborah Kentwell (Thunder Corps) to infiltrate Hardwater Security Svcs and procure evidence of cheating. Later re-hired to win the final War Game (CTF). Yuriko was forced to inhabit an Ares ShadowDancer WarMech (Deadly Arts).

session.name: 2026-June-20: SRM 2083-19 | The Hallow Feast
session.summary: : Hired by Monsieur Johnson to ascertain the whereabouts of Snaggletooth. Ultimately found him long since dead and possessed by a spirit attempting to destroy the world.

session.name: 2026-June-25: SRM 2081-05 | This is Renton
session.summary: The team was hired by upcoming rapper Swango to investigate death threats, discovering that her previous fixer, Brynne Taggart, had gone missing. While a summoned spirit tracked Brynne, the team traced the messages to a used electronics store in a mall hangout for the Night Hunters gang. Intimidating a member revealed their employer: a retired LoneStar captain leading the local Neighborhood Watch. Following the spirit's lead to a shabby hotel, the runners located Brynne, who confirmed their findings. Forewarned of an approaching hit squad, the team easily repelled them. Swango then hired them as concert security. During the performance, they repelled a frontal gang assault, and one runner took a bullet to protect Swango from a backstage assassin.

session.name: 2026-June-30: CMP 2083-01: NONPLUSHED
session.summary: Hired to locate and return a missing convoy of S-K trucks. Simon called, asking for information on why they were stolen. Trucks located, liberated, and returned. Lost two Johnsons on this one - Simon's looking into it.

session.name: 2026-July-07: SRM 2081-08 Child's Play
session.summary: : Hired by a CorpoKid to bodyguard him while he developed and sold a new neural interface for drones. A corp tried to steal it, but they failed.

session.name: 2026-July-09: SRM 2081-07 | Bootleg Bliss
session.summary: Hired by Ni Ni to eliminate a fool who was pawning off poor quality illicit drugs as Triad goods.

session.name: 2026-July-10: SRM 2081-06 | Cutting Strings
session.summary: Hired by a Johnson to find a friend.

session.name: CMP 2083-04 | Hog Wild
session.summary: Sigs asked us to track someone down for her and bring them back.

session.name: 2026-July-21: CMP 2083-05 | Precious Cargo
session.summary: HK Police raided an abandoned Red Dragon Triad operation at Kwai Chung Container Port. Reports indicate a human trafficking operation was broken up by a small team of Shadowrunners (including a pixie and a wolf) before police arrived. Additionally, Liao Fa Ren got top marks on her paper, which was published in the school paper and picked up by local outlets.

session.name: 2026-July-24: SRM 2083-12 | When You're Smiling
session.summary: NOLA Network News at 9 reported evidence linking Zobop / Red Tide Hitman, Mackenson “Mr. Smiley” Salomon to Blood Magic, Sacrifice, and murder was turned over to NOMS by a concerned citizen and member of the Koslowski family. Mr. Smiley seems to have departed the NOLA area.
